text:
Noah Kim: FYI scheduling a short maintenance for az9 GPU pool (az9-gpu-edge, ~38 GPUs) next Fri 23:30-00:45 UTC. Objective: BMC firmware refresh + NIC microcode. Rolling reboots in small cohorts.
Aisha Khan: Thanks. Soft drains or full evacuations?
Noah Kim: Soft drains. We'll cordon -> drain -> run microcode smoke checks -> uncordon. Cohorts of 3 nodes every 5m to limit impact.
Tom Reyes: If we spill traffic to us-central, egress cost could spike. Can we set a routing cap?
SRE-Julia: Set cross-az failover cap at 12% and enable gradual ramp (90s) per cohort. Also pre-seed KV caches and spin 4 backfill GPUs 20m prior.
Aisha Khan: Canary plan?
SRE-Julia: Two canary nodes. Validate with 200-sample inference suite and NVLINK CRC checks. Abort on any ECC/MCE.
Noah Kim: Quick capacity sim, please. If queued > 180 units we consider expanding fallback.
Tom Reyes: Sim results: peak queued 143 units, projected GPU util 83% during cohort 6. No two-region failover needed.
Aisha Khan: Cost estimate if we run fallback burst: ~14 GPU-hours at $3.10/hr = ~$43. Fine to charge infra-maint tag.
Noah Kim: Draft tenant comms below, please review: 

"Maintenance window: Fri 23:30-00:45 UTC in az9. Impact: brief capacity reduction in az9-gpu-edge. We will perform staggered node reboots and BMC/NIC updates. Some requests may be queued or routed to fallback region. If you need reserved capacity, reply with tenant id. Expect short increases in tail latency per cohort.

"
SRE-Julia: Add link to runbook and oncall contact. ops-bot: posting oncall.
ops-bot: Scheduled oncall: Primary - SRE-Julia, Backup - Tom Reyes for 2026-03-27 23:30 UTC window.
Noah Kim: Drain cmds: 

kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90

SRE-Julia: Validation greps: `journalctl -u bmc | grep -i error` and `dmesg | grep -E "MCE|PCIe|nvlink"`. Also run `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc` post-boot.
Tom Reyes: I'll prep the 24h and 1h notices. Noah, update the maintenance page and lock the runbook when ready.
Noah Kim: Will do. Closing checklist: comms posted, canary ready, oncall confirmed, finance tag set. :thumbsup:
